title: Maximize Consecutive Elements in an Array After Modification
accessAttempt: Official leetcode.com page not fetchable (HTTP 403). Statement obtained from leetcode.doocs.org/en/lc/3041/ via WebFetch, which paraphrased it (not verbatim).
summary: Given a 0-indexed array of positive integers, each element may be increased by at most 1. Return the maximum number of elements that can be selected so that their sorted values form a run of consecutive integers.
visualizationCap: nums.length capped at 30 and values at 60 for the visualization; the solution itself handles the stated limits.
